import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
turns = d.get("messages", [])
calls = [t for t in turns if t.get("type") == "tool_call"]
out = [{"header":{"route":"c_asst"}, "messages":calls}]
for c in calls:
    out.append({"header":{"route":"tool","tool_call_id":c.get("id","")}, "messages":[c]})
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))
